title: Log in with a numeric access code
description: This verifies that a user can authenticate with a valid numeric access code and enter the application successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid numeric access code
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Log in and create a player athlete successfully
description: This verifies that an admin can log in, open athlete onboarding, submit a valid JUGADOR record, and receive a generated access code after creation.
category: One-time access code display after creation

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with ADMIN001
Submit the login form
Click the link to start athlete creation
Select the player role
Fill in all required athlete details with valid values for a player
Submit the athlete form
Verify a blocking access code modal is displayed
Verify the created athlete is acknowledged in the success modal

title: Create an athlete as ADMIN with the full player profile
description: This verifies that an admin can create a new JUGADOR athlete from the full form and receive a generated one-time access code.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid admin access code
Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Select the athlete role
Fill in the required athlete profile fields with valid data
Submit the athlete form
Verify a blocking success modal is visible
Verify a generated one-time access code is displayed

title: Redirect non-admin users away from athlete creation
description: This verifies that users without admin access cannot open the athlete creation page and are redirected to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid non-admin access code
Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Verify the login page is visible
Verify the athlete creation form is not visible

title: Create an administrator athlete with the reduced form
description: This verifies that an admin can switch the form to ADMINISTRADOR, submit valid data with the reduced required fields, and receive a one-time access code.
category: One-time access code display after creation

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with ADMIN001
Submit the login form
Click the link to start athlete creation
Select the administrator role
Fill in the required athlete details with valid values for an administrator
Submit the athlete form
Verify a blocking access code modal is displayed
Verify the created athlete is acknowledged in the success modal

title: Create an administrator profile with reduced required fields
description: This verifies that an admin can switch to the administrator role, submit the reduced form, and receive a generated one-time access code.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid admin access code
Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Select the administrator role
Fill in the required administrator profile fields with valid data
Submit the athlete form
Verify a blocking success modal is visible
Verify a generated one-time access code is displayed

title: Create two athletes in one session
description: This verifies that after closing the success modal, the form resets and a second athlete can be created immediately with a new distinct access code.
category: One-time access code display after creation

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with ADMIN001
Submit the login form
Click the link to start athlete creation
Fill in all required athlete details with valid values for the first athlete
Submit the athlete form
Close the success modal
Fill in all required athlete details with valid values for a second athlete
Submit the athlete form
Verify a new access code modal is displayed for the second athlete
Verify the second code is different from the first code

title: Create two athletes back to back on the same page
description: This verifies that closing the success modal resets the form so an admin can create a second athlete immediately afterward and receive a new code.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid admin access code
Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Select the athlete role
Fill in the required athlete profile fields with valid data
Submit the athlete form
Close the success modal
Fill in the required athlete profile fields with different valid data
Submit the athlete form
Verify a second blocking success modal is visible
Verify a new generated one-time access code is displayed

title: Reset the form after closing the access code modal
description: This verifies that after a successful creation, closing the modal returns the form to a blank ready state for another entry.
category: One-time access code display after creation

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with ADMIN001
Submit the login form
Click the link to start athlete creation
Fill in all required athlete details with valid values
Submit the athlete form
Close the success modal
Verify the athlete creation form is reset to a blank state
Verify the form is ready for a new entry

title: Block invalid athlete input before saving
description: This verifies that invalid field values are rejected on the athlete form and validation errors are shown instead of creating the record.

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Select the athlete role
Fill in the athlete form with invalid values for required fields
Submit the athlete form
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the success modal is not visible

title: Switch to administrator fields and back to athlete fields
description: This verifies that changing the selected role updates the visible form sections and restores the athlete fields when switched back.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the access code field with a valid admin access code
Submit the login form
Click the link to add a new athlete
Select the administrator role
Select the athlete role
Verify the athlete-specific form sections are visible
Verify the administrator-only reduced section is not visible
